label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is the SQL string q containing param derived from request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest"). User input is directly concatenated into the UPDATE statement without sanitization or parameterization. Although execution occurs outside this method, the construction and storage of the vulnerable payload in the request context creates a viable injection vector.

evidence.note: User input param concatenated into SQL string q and stored in request attribute
